products.name: Pet Food and Treats
products.description: A wide assortment of pet food and treats, including premium and private label brands, sold online and delivered directly to customers via a large-scale fulfillment network.

products.name: Pet Supplies and Accessories
products.description: A broad range of pet supplies and accessories, such as toys, beds, crates, and grooming products, sourced from leading brands and private labels, sold through e-commerce platforms and shipped to customers.

products.name: Pet Medications and Pharmacy Services
products.description: Prescription and over-the-counter pet medications, including compounded medications, sold through Chewy Pharmacy, the largest online pet pharmacy in America, with fulfillment and delivery to customers.

products.name: Pet Health and Wellness Products
products.description: Health and wellness products for pets, including supplements, vitamins, and specialty diets, offered under both third-party and Chewy's private brands, delivered via e-commerce.

products.name: Pet Insurance and Wellness Plans (CarePlus)
products.description: Comprehensive pet insurance and wellness plans under the CarePlus brand, offering coverage options at varying price points, sold digitally to pet owners.

products.name: Veterinary Services (Chewy Vet Care Clinics)
products.description: In-person veterinary services including routine appointments, urgent care, and surgery, provided at Chewy Vet Care clinics powered by proprietary technology platforms.

products.name: Telehealth Veterinary Services (Connect with a Vet)
products.description: Online telehealth consultations with licensed veterinarians or veterinary technicians, accessible via Chewy’s digital platforms, including free access for certain customers.

products.name: Private Brand Pet Products
products.description: Pet consumables, hardgoods, and wellness products developed and marketed under Chewy’s own private brands, including Frisco, American Journey, Tylee’s, Vibeful, and Get Real, sold exclusively through Chewy’s platforms.

products.name: PracticeHub Veterinary E-commerce Platform
products.description: A cloud-based e-commerce and practice management platform for veterinary clinics, integrating with existing software to manage prescriptions, inventory, and fulfillment, enabling clinics to earn revenue while Chewy handles logistics.

products.name: Advertising Solutions for Vendor Partners
products.description: A suite of digital advertising solutions for pet product vendors, enabling brands to promote their products on Chewy’s e-commerce platforms.

products.name: Turbochargers for Internal Combustion Engines
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells turbochargers for gasoline, diesel, natural gas, and hydrogen internal combustion engines used in light vehicles, commercial vehicles (on- and off-highway), marine, and industrial applications. These are highly engineered mechanical products produced at scale in global manufacturing facilities and delivered to OEMs and aftermarket distributors.

products.name: Electric Air Compressors for Fuel Cell Vehicles
products.description: Provides a range of electric air compressors for hydrogen fuel cell vehicles and industrial fuel cell systems, using advanced high-speed electric motor technology. These are manufactured and supplied to OEMs to enable efficient air supply for fuel cell stacks, enhancing performance and range.

products.name: E-Powertrain Solutions
products.description: Develops and supplies electric traction (E-Powertrain) systems for battery electric and hybrid vehicles, leveraging proprietary high-speed motors, controls software, and power electronics. These are advanced digital and electromechanical systems integrated into OEM vehicle platforms.

products.name: E-Cooling Compressors for Electric and Hybrid Vehicles
products.description: Designs and manufactures electric cooling compressors for thermal management in electric and hybrid vehicles, as well as industrial applications such as HVAC and data center cooling. These are advanced electromechanical products produced for OEMs to improve energy efficiency and packaging.

products.name: Aftermarket Turbocharger and Performance Products
products.description: Sells replacement turbochargers, remanufactured turbochargers, and performance enhancement products under the Garrett brand through a global network of distributors and service centers. These products support the installed base of vehicles and offer both new and remanufactured options, including for industrial and marine applications.

products.name: Concrete Pumping Services
products.description: Provision of operated concrete pumping services using a fleet of truck-mounted and stationary pumps, delivered by skilled operators to construction sites for precise placement of ready-mix concrete. Services are billed based on time and volume, and are available for commercial, infrastructure, and residential projects in the U.S. and U.K.

products.name: Concrete Pumping Equipment Rental
products.description: Rental of concrete pumping equipment without an operator, primarily in the U.K., where customers hire mobile equipment for a minimum period to perform their own concrete placement.

products.name: Concrete Waste Management Services
products.description: Provision of full-service, route-based concrete washout and waste management solutions using custom metal pans and trucks, including delivery, pickup, and compliant disposal of concrete washout from construction sites in the U.S. and U.K.

products.name: Replacement Parts Sales
products.description: Sale of replacement parts for concrete pumping equipment to regional operators who lack the capital and scale to maintain their own inventory, supporting ongoing equipment maintenance needs.

products.name: Homeowners Insurance
products.description: Insurance policies covering residential property owners, delivered via Hippo's proprietary technology platform and partner MGAs. Policies are underwritten using advanced data analytics and distributed through direct and partner channels.

products.name: Renters Insurance
products.description: Short-tail personal lines insurance providing protection for personal property and contents of rented residences, underwritten by a third-party program administrator and distributed through Hippo's platform.

products.name: Casualty Insurance
products.description: Liability insurance products, including general liability, commercial auto liability, and excess/umbrella liability, written through delegated authority arrangements with program administrators and MGAs. Coverage responds to claims for bodily injury, property damage, and related defense costs.

products.name: Commercial Multi-Peril Insurance
products.description: Packaged commercial property and liability insurance for small to mid-sized businesses, including small business owners policies and industry-specific packages, distributed through third-party program administrators.

products.name: Specialty and Niche Insurance Programs
products.description: A range of specialty property programs and niche personal or commercial insurance products, including discontinued and runoff programs, evaluated independently for scalability and capital impact.

products.name: Ethereum Staking Services
products.description: The company allocates its ETH holdings to third-party validator operators to participate in the Ethereum proof-of-stake network and earn protocol-native staking rewards. This is a digital-only service, requiring financial capital and institutional-grade custody, but not physical infrastructure.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining Services
products.description: The company operates a fleet of specialized ASIC miners hosted in third-party data centers to mine bitcoin, generating digital assets as rewards. This business requires significant physical infrastructure, energy consumption, and ongoing maintenance, but is being wound down as the company transitions to an ETH focus.

products.name: High-Performance Computing (HPC) Data Center Services
products.description: Through its majority-owned subsidiary WhiteFiber, the company designs, develops, and operates Tier-3 data centers offering hosting and colocation services for AI and HPC workloads. These services require physical data center infrastructure, advanced cooling, power redundancy, and are delivered to enterprise and GPU cloud customers.

products.name: Cloud GPU Services for AI and Machine Learning
products.description: WhiteFiber provides cloud-based access to GPU servers for AI and machine learning workloads, offering on-demand or contracted compute power to enterprises, research institutions, and GPU marketplaces. This is delivered via owned and leased data center capacity, leveraging partnerships with hardware vendors and supporting rapid deployment for customer needs.

products.name: Prostate Cancer Genomic Testing (Decipher Prostate)
products.description: A molecular diagnostic test using whole-transcriptome analysis and machine learning on prostate tissue to assess tumor biology and estimate risk of metastatic disease, performed in CLIA-certified labs in the U.S. and as a decentralized IVD test internationally.

products.name: Thyroid Cancer Genomic Testing (Afirma)
products.description: A genomic sequencing classifier test using whole-transcriptome RNA sequencing and machine learning on fine needle aspiration biopsy samples to determine benign vs. malignant thyroid nodules, performed in CLIA-certified labs in the U.S.

products.name: Breast Cancer Genomic Testing (Prosigna Breast Cancer Assay)
products.description: A prognostic assay using advanced genomic technology to analyze the activity of 46 genes in breast cancer tissue, offered as an IVD test internationally and as an LDT in the U.S. (planned), to inform risk of recurrence and therapy decisions.

products.name: Bladder Cancer Genomic Testing (Decipher Bladder)
products.description: A genomic test measuring the molecular profile of bladder cancer using gene expression analysis from tumor specimens, performed in CLIA-certified labs in the U.S. to inform treatment decisions for high-grade non-muscle-invasive and muscle-invasive disease.

products.name: Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) Testing (TrueMRD Platform)
products.description: A whole-genome, AI-powered blood-based test platform for detecting minimal residual disease and monitoring cancer recurrence, leveraging genomic signatures from blood samples, with initial focus on muscle-invasive bladder cancer and plans for other indications.

products.name: Lung Cancer Risk Assessment (Percepta Nasal Swab Test)
products.description: A noninvasive genomic test using nasal swab samples to detect genomic changes associated with lung cancer, helping physicians assess cancer risk in patients with lung nodules and avoid unnecessary invasive procedures.

products.name: International In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) Test Kits
products.description: Distribution of molecular diagnostic test kits (notably Prosigna and, in the future, Decipher Prostate) for use in laboratories and hospitals outside the U.S., enabling local performance of cancer genomic tests on platforms such as the nCounter Analysis System and NextSeq 550Dx.

products.name: Data Center Cooling Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive cooling systems for data centers, including precision air conditioning units, air handlers, chillers, condensers, liquid cooling solutions, controls, and maintenance services. These are engineered, manufactured, and delivered as integrated systems or components, often with digital controls and sustainability features.

products.name: Heat Transfer Products and Coatings
products.description: Heat exchanger coils (primarily round tube plate fin construction) and anti-corrosive coatings for HVAC&R and industrial applications, manufactured and supplied to OEMs and distributors. Includes application services for coatings to extend equipment life.

products.name: HVAC&R Systems and Components
products.description: Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration systems and components for commercial, industrial, and residential buildings, including unit heaters, air handlers, chillers, condensing units, evaporator coolers, and related products. Manufactured and distributed globally, often requiring physical installation and compliance with regulations.

products.name: Air-Cooled Heat Exchangers and Modules
products.description: Air-cooled heat exchangers and cooling modules for vehicular, stationary power, and industrial applications, including radiators, condensers, engine cooling modules, charge air coolers, and generator set cooling modules. Manufactured for OEMs in commercial vehicle, off-highway, and power generation sectors.

products.name: Liquid-Cooled Heat Exchangers and Components
products.description: Liquid-cooled heat exchangers and related components for engine, stationary power, and industrial applications, including oil coolers, EGR coolers, liquid charge air coolers, and chillers. Produced for OEMs in commercial vehicle, automotive, and off-highway markets.

products.name: Advanced Thermal Solutions for Zero-Emission and Hybrid Vehicles
products.description: Thermal management systems and components for electric, hybrid, and fuel cell vehicles, including battery thermal management systems, electronics cooling packages, battery chillers, cooling plates, and e-axle coolers. Designed and manufactured for OEMs in commercial vehicle, bus, specialty vehicle, and automotive sectors.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial and multifamily real estate properties, including owner-occupied and investor real estate, hotels, retail, office, industrial, and agricultural real estate. Loans are physically originated and serviced through branch network and require regulated underwriting and collateral management.

products.name: Construction and Land Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to finance the construction of residential and non-residential properties, including commercial projects and land development. Loans are physically originated, monitored, and disbursed based on project completion, requiring in-person inspections and regulated oversight.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Offering of loans and lines of credit to businesses for working capital, equipment financing, expansion, and other business purposes, including SBA 7(a) loans. These require financial capital, regulated underwriting, and are delivered through relationship banking.

products.name: Small Business Administration (SBA) Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of SBA-guaranteed loans, including SBA 7(a) and 504 programs, for small businesses to finance real estate, equipment, and working capital. Requires specialized regulatory compliance and participation in federal programs.

products.name: One-to-Four Family Residential Lending
products.description: Holding and servicing of residential mortgage loans, including home equity loans and lines of credit, primarily acquired through mergers or loan purchases. Loans are secured by residential real estate and require regulated servicing.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans, including secured and unsecured personal loans and lines of credit, primarily as an accommodation to commercial clients. These are underwritten based on individual creditworthiness and delivered through branch network.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Offering of agricultural real estate and operating loans to finance farmland, equipment, and seasonal crop production. Loans are physically originated and require specialized underwriting based on agricultural cycles and collateral.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provision of a variety of deposit accounts, including demand, savings, money market, and time deposits, to individuals, businesses, and organizations. Delivered through branch network and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Treasury Management and Cash Management Services
products.description: Offering of commercial treasury management and cash management services, including remote deposit capture, lockbox, ACH, wire transfers, account reconciliation, and sweep accounts. Delivered digitally and through in-person support to business clients.

products.name: Online and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Provision of digital banking services, including online account access, mobile banking, remote check deposit, bill payment, and electronic statements, to both consumer and business clients. Delivered via proprietary digital platforms.

products.name: Financial Operations Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, AI-enabled software platform that automates and integrates accounts payable, accounts receivable, and spend and expense management for SMBs, delivered via desktop and mobile applications. The platform connects businesses, suppliers, and clients, and integrates with accounting systems, banks, and payment processors.

products.name: Accounts Payable Automation
products.description: A digital service that streamlines the entire accounts payable process, including bill receipt, approvals workflow, payment execution (ACH, check, card, wire), and synchronization with accounting systems, leveraging AI for data capture and document management.

products.name: Accounts Receivable Automation
products.description: A digital service that automates invoice creation, delivery, funds collection, and synchronization with accounting systems, including electronic and paper invoicing, branded client payment portals, and collaboration tools.

products.name: Spend and Expense Management
products.description: A software solution, including the BILL Divvy Card, that provides businesses with tools to issue corporate charge cards, build and monitor budgets, manage payments, and automate expense reporting and reimbursements, delivered via web and mobile apps.

products.name: Payment Services
products.description: A suite of payment processing services enabling ACH, card (physical, virtual, and Pay By Card), real-time payments, checks, cross-border payments, and invoice financing, integrated into the platform and accessible to customers for both payables and receivables.

products.name: Value-Added Financial Automation Services
products.description: A set of integrated features including two-way sync with accounting systems, purchase order matching, cash flow forecasting, treasury services, document management, and mobile functionality, enhancing automation and control for SMB financial operations.

products.name: Partner and API Integrations
products.description: Technology solutions enabling accounting firms, financial institutions, and software partners to integrate, white-label, or embed the platform’s financial automation and payment capabilities into their own offerings via APIs and embedded technology.

products.name: Lodging Property Ownership and Leasing
products.description: Ownership of lodging properties, primarily in the Upscale segment, which are leased to taxable REIT subsidiaries and operated under franchise agreements with major hotel brands. Properties are physically owned, require capital investment, and are managed by third-party operators.

products.name: Asset and Property Management Services for Joint Ventures
products.description: Provision of asset management and general partner services to joint ventures, including the GIC Joint Venture, for which the company earns management and incentive fees. Services are delivered through in-person management and oversight of lodging assets.

products.name: Selective Mezzanine Lending to Lodging Developers
products.description: Provision of mezzanine loans to lodging property developers, sometimes with the option to acquire the property after development. This is a financial service requiring capital deployment and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Market Making Services
products.description: Provision of liquidity and price competition by acting as a principal in buying and selling a broad range of securities and financial instruments across global equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities, options, and cryptocurrencies. This is enabled by proprietary, automated, multi-asset technology platforms integrated with exchanges and trading venues worldwide.

products.name: Agency Execution Services
products.description: Execution of trades as an agent for institutional clients in global equities, ETFs, fixed income, currencies, and commodities, using electronic and voice channels, including algorithmic trading, order routing, and access to alternative trading systems (ATSs). Services are delivered via proprietary and third-party platforms, with commissions earned per transaction.

products.name: Alternative Trading Systems (ATS) and Crossing Networks
products.description: Operation of registered ATSs and crossing networks (such as Virtu MatchIt and POSIT) that match client orders internally, providing non-displayed liquidity and block crossing mechanisms for equities and ETFs. These platforms are accessed by both internal and external subscribers.

products.name: Workflow Technology Platforms
products.description: Development and delivery of integrated, broker-neutral trading tools, including order and execution management systems (EMS/OMS), network connectivity, and commission management solutions. These digital platforms support multi-asset trading, compliance, and post-trade processes for institutional clients.

products.name: Trading Analytics and Data Products
products.description: Provision of analytics tools and data products for pre-trade, real-time, and post-trade analysis, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), risk models, portfolio optimization, and securities valuation. These digital services help clients improve execution performance and manage trading costs.

products.name: Capital Markets Services
products.description: Acting as an agent for issuers in connection with at-the-market offerings and buyback programs, facilitating capital raising and share repurchase activities for corporate clients. These services are delivered through regulated broker-dealer affiliates.

products.name: MAT2203 (Oral Amphotericin B)
products.description: MAT2203 is an oral formulation of amphotericin B, a potent antifungal drug, developed using the proprietary Lipid Nanocrystal (LNC) Platform. It is manufactured through encapsulation of amphotericin B in lipid nanocrystals, enabling oral delivery with reduced toxicity compared to traditional IV formulations. The product is intended for the treatment and prevention of invasive fungal infections, including aspergillosis, candidiasis, and cryptococcosis, particularly in immunocompromised patients.

products.name: MAT2203 Compassionate/Expanded Use Access Program
products.description: This program provides MAT2203 on a compassionate use basis to patients with serious or life-threatening invasive fungal infections who have no other treatment options. The product is delivered to eligible patients through partnerships with healthcare institutions and external medical consultants, outside of clinical trials.

products.name: Marine Seismic Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells specialized equipment for marine seismic surveys, including energy source controllers (GunLink), positioning systems (BuoyLink), and towed streamer systems (SeaLink). Products are physically manufactured and delivered to customers in the oceanographic, hydrographic, and seismic industries.

products.name: Marine Survey and Oceanographic Equipment
products.description: Produces and sells equipment used for oceanographic and hydrographic surveys, including sensors, transducers, and array systems. These products are manufactured and shipped to marine survey companies, research institutes, and governmental organizations.

products.name: Maritime Security and Defense Sensors
products.description: Develops and sells hydrophone and solid streamer technologies that can be used in maritime security applications, such as anti-submarine warfare and underwater object detection. These are manufactured products intended for security and defense customers.

products.name: Product-Related Services (Repair, Training, Field Service)
products.description: Provides services related to its manufactured products, including repair, training, field service operations, and umbilical terminations. These services are delivered in-person by technical staff at customer or company facilities.

products.name: Spectral Ai Software Licensing
products.description: Licenses proprietary data handling and automatic target recognition software (Spectral Ai) for use with marine survey and sonar systems. This is a digital product delivered via licensing agreements, with recurring fees.

products.name: Digital Watermarking Solutions
products.description: Software and technology solutions that embed digital watermarks into physical and digital media for authentication, identification, and tracking. Delivered via a cloud-based SaaS platform and integrated into customer systems through APIs and workflows.

products.name: Currency Counterfeiting Deterrence Systems
products.description: Specialized systems and services for central banks to deter digital counterfeiting of global currencies, including software development and ongoing support. Involves long-term contracts and proprietary technology integration.

products.name: Retail Loss Prevention Solutions
products.description: Digital and software-based solutions for retailers to prevent loss from shrink, theft, and product swaps, including integration with retail scanners and checkout systems. Delivered through software and hardware partnerships.

products.name: Product Authentication and Anti-Counterfeiting Solutions
products.description: Solutions for brands and manufacturers to authenticate products and prevent counterfeiting, including counterfeit-resistant packaging, security labels, and mobile verification. Delivered via digital watermarks and secure labels.

products.name: Digital Asset Protection and Integrity Solutions
products.description: Software solutions to protect digital assets, ensure compliance, detect leaks, prevent piracy, and monitor royalties. Delivered through the Illuminate SaaS platform and integrated with customer digital workflows.

products.name: Recycling and Sustainability Solutions
products.description: Technology for automated sorting and tracking of post-consumer plastic packaging to enable advanced recycling and support sustainability initiatives. Delivered through digital watermarking and validated in industrial-scale trials.

products.name: Gift Card Security Solutions
products.description: End-to-end digital security solutions for gift cards, including tamper detection and fraud prevention, integrated with retail point-of-sale systems and scanners.

products.name: Audio Watermarking Solutions
products.description: Next-generation audio watermarking technology for content authentication, authorship verification, and royalty tracking, aimed at creators and media companies. Delivered as software integrated into digital media workflows.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Includes checking and savings accounts, credit and debit cards, and lending products such as home, auto, personal, and small business loans. Delivered primarily through physical branches, digital platforms, and ATMs, requiring regulated infrastructure and significant human labor.

products.name: Wealth and Investment Management Services
products.description: Personalized wealth management, brokerage, financial planning, lending, private banking, trust and fiduciary services for individuals and institutions. Delivered via financial advisors, digital platforms, and regulated entities.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Banking and credit products for private, family owned, and public companies, including secured lending, lease products, and treasury management. Delivered through relationship managers, digital channels, and regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Corporate and Investment Banking Services
products.description: Capital markets, investment banking, treasury management, commercial real estate lending and servicing, equity and fixed income solutions, as well as sales, trading, and research for corporate, government, and institutional clients. Delivered via specialized teams, digital platforms, and regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Mortgage Products and Services
products.description: Origination, servicing, and management of residential mortgage loans for consumers. Delivered through branch networks, digital channels, and specialized mortgage teams, subject to extensive regulation.

products.name: Cardiac Recovery System Platform
products.description: A comprehensive, integrated platform combining wearable medical devices, digital health solutions, and patient support services for cardiac patients. It includes physical manufacturing of devices, cloud-based digital platforms, and in-person support, all delivered as a unified solution to monitor, diagnose, and treat patients at risk of sudden cardiac arrest and other cardiac conditions.

products.name: ASSURE Wearable Cardioverter Defibrillator (WCD)
products.description: A next-generation, wearable, non-invasive automated external defibrillator designed to continuously monitor heart rhythms and deliver defibrillation therapy to patients at elevated risk of sudden cardiac arrest. The device is physically manufactured, FDA-approved, and provided to patients via a lease model, including fitting, training, and support services.

products.name: ASSURE Wearable ECG
products.description: A wearable, non-therapeutic ECG monitoring device for patients no longer indicated for a WCD but who require ongoing cardiac monitoring and connectivity. It is physically manufactured and integrates with the Cardiac Recovery System platform, providing extended monitoring and digital data transmission to clinicians.

products.name: Integrated Digital Health Solutions and Services
products.description: A suite of digital health products and services, including the ASSURE patient application, Kestra CareStation remote patient data platform, Heart Alert Services, and ASSURE Assist services. These are cloud-based and mobile solutions that enable real-time patient engagement, remote monitoring, critical alerts, and provider workflow integration, delivered digitally and supported by in-person specialists.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: A full suite of commercial banking products including deposit accounts, cash management, and relationship-based services, delivered through physical branches and digital platforms, primarily to values-based businesses, nonprofits, unions, and political organizations.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Retail banking products such as checking and savings accounts, certificates of deposit, debit and ATM cards, online and mobile banking, and bill payment services, delivered through branches and digital channels to individual consumers.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: A range of lending products for businesses and organizations, including commercial and industrial (C&I) loans, bridge financing, loans to political organizations, and specialty lending for mission-aligned sectors, underwritten with relationship-based and risk-managed processes.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Loans secured by commercial real estate properties such as office buildings, retail centers, industrial facilities, mixed-use buildings, and education centers, primarily in the New York metropolitan area, with stringent underwriting and risk management.

products.name: Multifamily Real Estate Lending
products.description: Loans to multifamily residential properties, predominantly rent-stabilized buildings in New York, with a focus on affordable housing and strict loan-to-value and debt service coverage requirements.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and referral of residential mortgage loans for one-to-four family dwellings, including affinity mortgage programs for union members, delivered through direct origination and a marketing services agreement with Embrace Home Loans.

products.name: Consumer Lending (Residential Solar Loans)
products.description: Consumer loans, predominantly for residential solar installations, provided to individual customers to finance renewable energy improvements.

products.name: Trust and Custody Services
products.description: Institutional trust and custody services including asset safekeeping, corporate actions, income collections, proxy services, account transition, asset transfers, and conversion management, tailored for pension funds, endowments, foundations, and family offices.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Investment management for institutional and retail clients, offering both index and actively-managed funds across equity, fixed-income, real estate, and alternative strategies, with a focus on socially responsible investing and shareholder advocacy.

products.name: Brokerage and Insurance Products (via Third-Party)
products.description: Investment, brokerage, asset management, and insurance products offered to retail customers through a third-party broker dealer, expanding the range of financial solutions available to individuals.

products.name: Securities Investment Portfolio
products.description: Investment in high-quality securities including mortgage-backed securities, asset-backed securities, and Property Assessed Clean Energy (PACE) investments, managed for risk-adjusted returns and liquidity.

products.name: Cellular Connectivity Products
products.description: Hardware products including cellular routers and modules that provide wireless connectivity using LTE, 5G, and other cellular protocols. These are manufactured using contract manufacturing and are delivered as physical devices to OEMs and enterprises for integration into their systems.

products.name: Embedded Wireless and RF Modules
products.description: Embedded wireless modules and off-the-shelf gateways, modems, and adapters supporting Zigbee, Cellular, Sub-1 GHz, LPWA, WiFi, and Bluetooth protocols. These are manufactured hardware components sold to OEMs and enterprises for integration into products requiring wireless communication.

products.name: Embedded System Products (SOMs and Single Board Computers)
products.description: Embedded system-on-modules (SOMs) and single board computers marketed under Digi Connect and ConnectCore brands, providing integrated computing platforms with wired and wireless connectivity for OEM integration. These are manufactured hardware platforms designed for scalable performance and long lifecycles.

products.name: Infrastructure Management Products
products.description: Serial servers, USB solutions, and related hardware for secure and reliable integration of devices into wired Ethernet networks, enabling remote management and monitoring of critical infrastructure. These are manufactured hardware products used in enterprise and industrial environments.

products.name: Device and Network Management Software Platforms
products.description: Recurring revenue software services including Digi Remote Manager (on-premise) and Lighthouse (cloud-based) that provide secure, centralized management, monitoring, and automation of connected devices and network infrastructure. Delivered digitally as SaaS or on-premise software.

products.name: Technical and Professional Services
products.description: Professional services including solution planning, implementation, application development, customer training, data plan subscriptions, and enhanced technical support for customers deploying Digi hardware and software. Delivered through in-person and remote human labor.

products.name: SmartSense Condition Monitoring Solutions
products.description: End-to-end hardware-enabled software solutions for wireless temperature and condition-based monitoring, employee task management, and supply chain visibility, primarily for food service, healthcare, and logistics. Delivered as a combination of sensors, gateways, and cloud-based applications, typically on a subscription basis.

products.name: Task and Workforce Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based task management, workforce management, and labeling solutions (primarily via Jolt) for retail, hospitality, and food service businesses, enabling digital food safety compliance and employee performance tracking. Delivered as SaaS with optional hardware components.

products.name: Managed Network-as-a-Service (MNaaS) Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive managed network services (MNaaS) including wireless and fixed-line WAN connectivity, security, and customized network solutions for sectors such as banking, healthcare, retail, and gaming. Delivered as a subscription-based service with hardware and software components, primarily through the Ventus brand.

products.name: Customer Platform (including Engagement Hubs and Smart CRM)
products.description: A unified, cloud-based software platform integrating AI-powered agents, Smart CRM, and engagement Hubs for marketing, sales, service, operations, content management, and commerce. Delivered as a multi-tenant SaaS solution accessible via web or mobile, it provides a single login, unified customer view, and extensible architecture with third-party integrations.

products.name: Marketing Hub
products.description: An integrated marketing automation suite enabling businesses to create brand awareness, orchestrate campaigns, and manage customer engagement across channels. Features include email, social media, SEO, AEO, automation, and analytics, delivered digitally via the platform.

products.name: Sales Hub
products.description: A digital sales enablement suite providing tools for sales teams to manage pipelines, automate sales processes, and engage prospects. Includes email templates, live chat, meeting scheduling, lead scoring, quoting, forecasting, and reporting, all delivered via the cloud platform.

products.name: Service Hub
products.description: Customer service software for managing and responding to customer inquiries, support tickets, and feedback. Delivered digitally, it includes live chat, bots, help desk, automation, knowledge base, and reporting tools.

products.name: Content Hub
products.description: A combined content management and CRM platform enabling businesses to create, personalize, and optimize web content, blogs, video, and podcasts. Delivered as a digital SaaS solution, it supports website management, SEO, analytics, and lead conversion.

products.name: Operations Hub
products.description: A digital operations suite for automating business processes, syncing and cleaning customer data, and enabling customer insights. Features programmable automation, data sync, curation, and quality tools, all delivered via the cloud platform.

products.name: Commerce Hub
products.description: A B2B commerce suite streamlining the opportunity-to-cash process, including payment processing, invoicing, quotes, subscription management, and revenue reporting. Delivered digitally, it enables businesses to accept electronic payments and automate billing.

products.name: Professional Services (Onboarding, Training, Consulting)
products.description: Fee-based services providing onboarding, training, and consulting to help customers implement and maximize the value of the customer platform. Delivered primarily via web meetings, online modules, and occasionally in-person sessions.

products.name: Pancreatic Cancer Screening Tests
products.description: Non-invasive diagnostic tests for early detection of pancreatic cancer, developed using proprietary mRNA biomarkers and AI algorithms, delivered via blood or stool samples. These tests require advanced genetic diagnostic technology and clinical validation.

products.name: Colorectal Cancer Screening Tests (ColoAlert and Next-Generation mRNA-based CRC Screening)
products.description: In-vitro diagnostic tests for early detection of colorectal cancer, including the CE-IVD certified ColoAlert multitarget stool test and next-generation mRNA-based CRC screening tests. These products use PCR and mRNA biomarker analysis, combining genetic and immunochemical testing, and are manufactured and validated for laboratory use.

products.name: Helicase-Primase Inhibitors for Recurrent Genital Herpes
products.description: Orally administered, long-acting small molecule antiviral drugs (HPIs) developed for the treatment of recurrent genital herpes (HSV-1 and HSV-2). These are produced through pharmaceutical R&D and delivered as oral therapeutics, with clinical development and commercialization now led by Gilead.

products.name: Hepatitis Delta Virus (HDV) Entry Inhibitor
products.description: An orally bioavailable small molecule entry inhibitor targeting the NTCP receptor to prevent HDV infection of hepatocytes. Developed through pharmaceutical R&D and delivered as an oral therapeutic for HDV, currently in clinical development.

products.name: Capsid Assembly Modulator for Hepatitis B Virus (HBV)
products.description: A next-generation, orally administered small molecule (CAM) designed to disrupt the HBV replication cycle and prevent cccDNA formation. Developed through pharmaceutical R&D and delivered as an oral therapeutic for HBV, currently in clinical development and seeking partners for further advancement.

products.name: Broad-Spectrum Non-Nucleoside Polymerase Inhibitor for Transplant-Associated Herpesviruses
products.description: An oral, broad-spectrum non-nucleoside polymerase inhibitor (NNPI) developed for the treatment of transplant-associated herpesvirus infections (including CMV, HSV-1, HSV-2, VZV, EBV). Produced via pharmaceutical R&D and delivered as an oral therapeutic, currently in regulatory filing-enabling studies.

products.name: Grid Power Quality and Resiliency Systems
products.description: Integrated systems including D-VAR, actiVAR, armorVAR, D-VAR VVO, REG, and related planning services, designed and manufactured to enhance the capacity, reliability, and efficiency of electric transmission and distribution grids. Delivered as turnkey solutions involving proprietary hardware, software, and engineering services, primarily to utilities and industrial customers.

products.name: Industrial Power Conversion and Conditioning Systems
products.description: Custom-engineered power conversion solutions including transformers, DC rectifiers, voltage compensators, capacitors, and harmonic filters for industrial and manufacturing applications such as semiconductor, mining, chemical, and materials processing. These systems are manufactured and tailored to customer specifications for high-reliability, high-capacity industrial power needs.

products.name: Marine Ship Protection and Power Systems
products.description: Advanced high-temperature superconductor (HTS)-based ship protection systems (SPS), degaussing systems, onboard power delivery, power generation, and electric propulsion systems for naval fleets. These are engineered, manufactured, and installed for military customers, providing enhanced performance, reduced weight, and increased efficiency.

products.name: Wind Turbine Electrical Control Systems and Components
products.description: Manufactured electrical control systems (ECS) and power electronics for wind turbines, designed to regulate voltage, control power flows, and maximize turbine efficiency. Delivered as core components to wind turbine manufacturers globally.

products.name: Wind Turbine Designs and Licensing
products.description: Design and development of onshore and offshore wind turbine platforms (2 MW and higher), licensed to manufacturers for upfront fees and royalties. Includes engineering expertise, patent rights, and ongoing access to technological advances, enabling customers to produce standardized or next-generation turbines.

products.name: Wind Turbine Customer Support Services
products.description: Engineering and technical support services for wind turbine manufacturers, including plant design, supply chain establishment, employee training, and field services. Delivered by specialized engineering teams to accelerate customer market entry and reduce costs.

products.name: Power Supplies and Military-Grade Magnetics
products.description: Manufactured power supplies for industrial electrostatic precipitators and military-grade magnetics (transformers, inductors) for shipboard, land-based, and airborne electrical systems. Products are engineered for high performance and durability in demanding environments.

products.name: Engines and Power Systems
products.description: Designs, engineers, manufactures, and sells emission-certified internal combustion engines and integrated power systems powered by natural gas, propane, biofuels, gasoline, and diesel, for use in power systems, industrial, and transportation markets. Products are manufactured in-house or sourced, and delivered as basic engines or fully packaged systems with integrated components.

products.name: Electric Power Generation Systems (Gensets)
products.description: Manufactures and sells mobile and stationary electric power generation systems, including large custom genset enclosures, for standby, rental, prime power, demand response, microgrid, oil & gas, data center, and renewable energy resiliency applications. These systems are engineered, tested, and validated to meet regulatory and customer requirements.

products.name: Combined Heat and Power (CHP) Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures integrated combined heat and power systems that provide both electricity and thermal energy, primarily for industrial and commercial applications. These systems are engineered to meet emissions and efficiency standards.

products.name: Industrial Engines and Power Systems
products.description: Produces and sells engines and integrated power systems for industrial applications such as material handling, agricultural and arbor care, irrigation, construction, compressors, utility vehicles, and other specialized equipment. Products are tailored to OEM and end-user requirements.

products.name: Transportation Engines and Power Systems
products.description: Manufactures and sells engines and integrated power systems for transportation vehicles, including trucks, buses, and specialty vehicles. Products include fuel systems and tanks for Class 2-7 vocational trucks and vans, school buses, transit buses, and terminal/utility tractors.

products.name: Battery Packs and Electrification Components
products.description: Offers battery packs and electrification components for industrial applications, including integration into power systems and equipment. These products are sourced or engineered and delivered as part of 'New Energy' solutions.

products.name: Aftermarket and Service Parts
products.description: Provides aftermarket and service parts programs, including sales and distribution of replacement parts and components for engines and power systems. Programs support both internal and OEM-developed service parts for products supplied by the company, with global distribution capabilities.

products.name: Evolve Fertility Control Baits
products.description: A line of non-lethal, fertility control soft bait products (Evolve Rat and Evolve Mouse) designed to reduce reproduction in rat and mouse populations. Manufactured using food-grade ingredients, primarily cottonseed oil, and delivered as palatable baits for sustained consumption. Products are produced at the company's Arizona facility and distributed in the U.S. and internationally.

products.name: ContraPest Fertility Control Bait
products.description: A liquid bait product containing VCD and triptolide as active ingredients, designed to reduce fertility in male and female rats. Manufactured at the company's Arizona facility, ContraPest is registered for sale in all 50 U.S. states and select territories, and is delivered via bait stations, including the Elevate Bait System for hard-to-reach areas.

products.name: Land Development and Sales
products.description: Development, planning, entitlement, construction, and sale of residential, resort, commercial, agricultural, and industrial real estate, primarily through physical land development and property sales on Maui.

products.name: Commercial, Industrial, and Agricultural Leasing
products.description: Leasing of commercial, retail, industrial, and agricultural land and properties, including restaurants, retail outlets, office buildings, warehouses, and large-scale agricultural and ranching land, delivered through long-term lease agreements.

products.name: Water Utility Services
products.description: Operation and sale of potable and non-potable water through owned wells, irrigation ditches, reservoirs, and transmission systems serving resorts, municipalities, and agricultural users, requiring regulated infrastructure and utility management.

products.name: Trademark and Trade Name Licensing
products.description: Licensing of registered trademarks and trade names, such as Kapalua and Maui Gold, to external companies, primarily in conjunction with agricultural, commercial, and industrial activities.

products.name: Resort Club Memberships and Amenities
products.description: Operation of the Kapalua Club, a private, non-equity club providing members with access to resort amenities such as spa, fitness center, private dining, and golf courses, delivered through membership programs and hospitality services.

products.name: Sephience (sepiapterin) for PKU
products.description: A small molecule therapeutic manufactured via synthetic chemical processes, delivered orally, for the treatment of phenylketonuria (PKU) in children and adults. Distributed globally through specialty pharmacies and commercial channels.

products.name: Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD) Franchise (Translarna and Emflaza)
products.description: Pharmaceutical products (Translarna and Emflaza) for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy, manufactured via synthetic processes and delivered orally (tablets and suspension). Translarna is marketed outside the US, Emflaza in the US, distributed via specialty pharmacies and hospital channels.

products.name: Upstaza/Kebilidi (eladocagene exuparvovec) Gene Therapy for AADC Deficiency
products.description: A gene therapy product manufactured using adeno-associated virus (AAV) technology, administered via a single neurosurgical procedure for the treatment of Aromatic L-Amino Decarboxylase (AADC) deficiency. Commercially supplied in the EEA, UK, and US.

products.name: Tegsedi (inotersen) for hATTR Amyloidosis
products.description: An antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) therapeutic, manufactured using proprietary nucleic acid synthesis, for the treatment of hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis (hATTR) with polyneuropathy. Commercialized in Latin America and the Caribbean under license.

products.name: Waylivra (volanesorsen) for FCS and FPL
products.description: An antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) therapeutic, manufactured via nucleic acid synthesis, for the treatment of familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS) and familial partial lipodystrophy (FPL). Commercialized in Latin America and the Caribbean under license.

products.name: Evrysdi (risdiplam) for Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA)
products.description: An orally bioavailable small molecule splicing modifier, manufactured via chemical synthesis, for the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in adults and children. Commercialized globally through a partnership with Roche.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of one- to four-family residential mortgage loans, primarily non-conforming, secured by owner-occupied and investment properties, including specialized programs for diverse communities. Loans are originated through brokers and branch network, and may be held for investment or sold to investors.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Provision of loans secured by multifamily, owner-occupied, and non-owner occupied commercial properties, including mixed-use, offices, warehouses, retail centers, and hotels. Loans are underwritten with a focus on high quality credits and strong collateral profiles.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Offering variable and fixed rate loans to small and medium-sized businesses for working capital, business expansion, trade financing, equipment purchases, and other business purposes. Includes both secured and unsecured loans, revolving lines of credit, and term loans.

products.name: Small Business Administration (SBA) and USDA Lending
products.description: Origination of government-guaranteed loans, primarily SBA 7(a) and USDA loans, to small businesses for working capital, real estate, equipment, or business expansion. Loans are originated to hold for investment or for sale of the guaranteed portion.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Provision of loans for commercial construction and land acquisition and development, typically secured by commercial properties. These loans are short-term, often with interest reserves, and are Prime-based with maturities under 24 months.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offering personal loans to individuals, including home equity loans, bridge loans, and other personal purpose loans, on both secured and unsecured bases. Delivered through branch network and brokers.

products.name: Deposit and Transaction Accounts
products.description: Provision of a variety of deposit products to businesses, consumers, and municipalities, including checking, NOW, money market, savings, and time deposit accounts. Delivered through branch network and business banking centers.

products.name: Municipal Banking Services
products.description: Banking services and deposit products tailored to public municipalities, including counties, cities, towns, and school districts, primarily in the Long Island area. Focused on long-term relationships and cost-effective deposit gathering.

products.name: Business Banking Services for the Legal, Licensed Cannabis Industry
products.description: Provision of business banking services, including deposit accounts, to legal, licensed cannabis businesses, initially in New York state. Delivered through specialized business banking offerings.

products.name: Home Goods and Furnishings
products.description: A comprehensive array of home-related products including furniture, bedding, bath essentials, patio and outdoor furniture, area rugs, tabletop and cookware, décor, storage, jewelry, watches, and fashion, primarily sold through an e-commerce platform and select physical stores. Products are sourced from third-party manufacturers and shipped directly to customers via an asset-light supply chain.

products.name: Add-On Services (Warranties, Shipping Insurance, Installation)
products.description: Supplementary services offered alongside product sales, including product warranties, shipping insurance, and installation services, delivered digitally or via third-party partners through the e-commerce platform.

products.name: Business Advertising Opportunities
products.description: Advertising services for businesses to showcase their products or services on the company's e-commerce platform, providing exposure to the retailer's customer base. Delivered digitally via the website.

products.name: Marketplace Services for Partners
products.description: A service enabling third-party partners to list and sell their products on the company's marketplace and on third-party sites, expanding sales channels and visibility. Delivered digitally via integration with the e-commerce platform.

products.name: Supplier Oasis Integration and Fulfillment Services
products.description: A digital platform for suppliers and partners to manage products, inventory, and sales channels, including access to multi-channel fulfillment services through the company's distribution network.

products.name: Personal Residential Property Insurance
products.description: Insurance policies covering homeowners, renters/tenants, condo unit owners, and dwelling/fire, including allied lines, liability, and personal property. Products are underwritten and distributed via independent agents and digital channels, requiring regulatory compliance and risk management.

products.name: Claims Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive claims processing and adjusting services, including field inspections, litigation management, and subrogation, delivered through in-house teams and third-party adjusters. Services leverage technology for efficiency and are provided both for internal insurance entities and for claims ceded to reinsurers.

products.name: Insurance Agency and Distribution Services
products.description: Distribution of property and casualty insurance products through a network of independent agents and direct-to-consumer digital platforms, including a digital agency that partners with third-party carriers. Services include agent training, technology support, and commission-based placement of insurance.

products.name: Reinsurance Brokerage and Placement Services
products.description: Placement and management of reinsurance programs for insurance entities, including negotiation with third-party reinsurers and government entities. Services are provided through a licensed reinsurance intermediary and generate commission revenue.

products.name: Livestock, Equine & Agriculture Products
products.description: A broad range of livestock and equine feed, farm and ranch equipment, fencing, poultry supplies, sprayers, and agricultural chemicals, sold through large-format retail stores and online. These products are physically manufactured and require regulated supply chains and distribution networks.

products.name: Companion Animal Products and Services
products.description: Pet food, treats, equipment, and wellness products for dogs, cats, and other small animals, sold through retail stores and digital platforms. Includes pet specialty retail (Petsense) and online pet pharmacy (Allivet), requiring regulated distribution and, for pharmacy, licensed fulfillment.

products.name: Seasonal & Recreation Products
products.description: Seasonal merchandise including lawn and garden supplies, tractors and riding equipment, bird feeding products, outdoor power equipment, and recreational items, sold in-store and online. These are physically manufactured goods with significant seasonal inventory management.

products.name: Truck, Tool & Hardware Products
products.description: Truck accessories, trailers, generators, lubricants, batteries, hardware, and tools, sold through retail stores and online. These are tangible goods requiring physical distribution and inventory management.

products.name: Clothing, Gift & Décor
products.description: Apparel, footwear, toys, snacks, and decorative merchandise, sold in-store and online. These are consumer goods sourced from various vendors and distributed through retail and digital channels.

products.name: Pet Pharmacy Services
products.description: Online pharmacy services for pet and animal medications, including prescription fulfillment, expert pharmacy advice, and auto-ship programs, delivered digitally and via licensed distribution centers.

products.name: Pet Grooming and Specialty Services
products.description: Pet grooming and specialty services offered through Petsense by Tractor Supply retail locations, requiring in-person human labor and regulated facilities.
